notes: Modified cash basis, treated as cash. Governmental columns from the Total Governmental Funds statement (p5); beginning/ending are fund balances 290,165/359,289 (ending includes due from other funds 110,555). Other general receipts 57,324 split using the statement of activities (charges 48,754 + licenses 6,375 + misc 2,195). Business-type from proprietary statement p7 (total column); office supplies printed digits unclear, 966 used because it ties to the column sum and to total 661,001. Business-type balances ties: 450,540 - 212,213 = 238,327. Budget schedule is all funds; revenue 'Other local sources' split into governmental/business using statements; its budget 500,000 not split. Proprietary expense lines split by column: Apartments column amounts (p7) are housing, the rest utilities. Business 'Other' operating receipts 6,042 split using p3 general receipts (investment 3,760, licenses 572, misc 1,710 = 4,176 less non-operating 2,466). Budget schedule expenditure lines use fund 'All funds' (department = fund/function) so they tie to Total Expenditures 882,961; combined debt service lines split into principal/interest from p5/p7. Statement of net position total column used for balance sheet. Read pages 1-9 of 9 Detail (user 2026-10-27): per-fund lines from the fund statements' columns (p5, p7) replace the combined schedule.
